messages:
Aisha R: Hi team! Quick onboarding questions: 1) When does my dental & medical actually kick in? My offer says start 2026-04-15. 2) What's the deadline to enroll in FSA/HSA? 3) My bank routing/account on the payroll portal looks wrong (ends with 3210 but my acct ends 1234) 914 4) Do I accrue company holidays pro-rated if I start mid-month? Thanks!

Maya (People Ops): Welcome Aisha 44b Nice to have you! Short answers up front: medical/dental = usually 1st of the month after start, FSA/HSA = enroll within 30 days of your start date, payroll bank fixes via payroll portal or payroll@redwood.com, holidays = prorated for mid-joiners. I'll expand below.

ZenBenefits Bot: Coverage rule: "standard_new_hire_effective_date" -> first of month after start. Exception: if prior coverage ended earlier we can request retro effective with proof. See https://benefits.redwood.com/new-hires

Aisha R: OK so with my 2026-04-15 start that means 2026-05-01 for benefits? That could leave a coverage gap.

Maya (People Ops): Correct by default it's 2026-05-01. If you have a gap (e.g., prior coverage ended 2026-04-14 or earlier), please upload proof of termination/COBRA notice to benefits@redwood.com and request an exception. Include the last day of previous coverage and we'll escalate.

Aisha R: Got it. About FSA/HSA: I had an HSA at my old job. Can I transfer funds or keep contribution election?

Juan (Payroll): HSA funds stay with your old HSA trustee; we cannot transfer accounts internally. For payroll contributions: if you elect HSA here and you're eligible (on HDHP), we can start contributions going forward. FSA elections are per-plan-year and generally irrevocable for the plan year (exceptions for qualifying life events). You must enroll within 30 days of your hire date to have pretax deductions.

Chris L: Aisha, I was in the same boat last month. Tip: enroll in HSA quickly if you want employer contributions. Also confirm your legal name on payroll matches your bank account holder name or direct deposit will fail.

Aisha R: Thanks Chris. Re: direct deposit, how do I correct the routing/account? The portal UI only lets me upload a bank doc but not edit the numbers.

Juan (Payroll): Sometimes the vendor (PayFlow) locks the first submission. Two options: 1) Reply to payroll@redwood.com with a voided check or bank letter and we will update it on our side (include full acct/routing numbers). 2) Use the self-service link in Workday > Pay > Direct Deposit > Edit (if available). If you email payroll, put subject: "Direct Deposit Update - Aisha R" and include last 4 of correct acct and attachment. We do not post full account numbers in Slack for security.

Aisha R: I'll email payroll now.

Maya (People Ops): Holiday accrual: Redwood grants X paid company holidays per year (check benefits portal). For mid-month starts we prorate based on days in the service month. Example: if a holiday occurs before your start date you are not eligible for it; if after, you are. If you start between 1st-15th we count the month as full for accrual; if 16th or later it's prorated. If you want a concrete calc for your start date send me your start and I'll compute.

Aisha R: Start is 2026-04-15. Can you compute?

Maya (People Ops): Sure. For 2026 our policy: employees get 8 company holidays. With a 2026-04-15 start we treat April as half-month => holiday accruals for the year will be prorated. Rough calc: 8 * ( (12 - 3) / 12 ) = 8 * 0.75 = 6 holidays available to you in 2026 (rounded down). I'll confirm with HR but plan on 6.

HR Bot: Confirmed: system will grant 6 company holidays for 2026 for employees starting 2026-04-15.

Aisha R: Amazing, thanks! Follow-ups: 1) I'll email payroll the voided check, 2) I'll attach prior COBRA termination to benefits@redwood.com, 3) where do I enroll for FSA/HSA?

Maya (People Ops): Enroll at https://benefits.redwood.com/enroll or open the benefits task in Workday. If you don't see the enrollment task, message benefits@redwood.com and we'll trigger it. Deadlines: 30 days from 2026-04-15 (so by 2026-05-15).

Aisha R: Sent payroll email and benefits upload. Thanks everyone :tada:

ZenBenefits Bot: Ticket created: BEN-2026-0457 (benefits docs received). Payroll ticket: PAY-2026-0783 (direct deposit update requested). Expect payroll update within one pay cycle once verified.

Juan (Payroll): Thanks Aisha. We'll reply if we need further docs. If you notice a missing paycheck or misdirected deposit, ping payroll immediately and cc your manager.

Chris L: Welcome again! Ping me if you want help with the Workday flow.

Aisha R: Will do 64c Thanks everyone!

HR Bot: Thread closed automatically after 7 days of inactivity."
